navigation.workspace_navigation: Each workspace owns its secondary tabs; individual tools are not global top-level navigation items.
navigation.home_layout: Preserve the current BASE scoreboard, command-card area, and roster section.

workspaces.title: Postgame Reports
workspaces.description: Generate the existing BASE postgame PDFs for each position group.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Group the existing generators without changing their calculations or report layouts during the navigation migration.

workspaces.title: Pitching
workspaces.description: Evaluate Texas State pitchers, bullpen work, staff trends, and pitching leaderboards.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Use Wally PitchingApp processing and workflows, restyled to the BASE design system and sourced from the season, squad, and bullpen CSVs in WallyApps/PitchingApp/data.

workspaces.title: Hitting
workspaces.description: Evaluate Texas State hitters, build lineups, review team trends, and compare hitting performance.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Use Wally HittingApp processing and workflows, restyled to the BASE design system and sourced from the season and squad CSVs in WallyApps/HittingApp/data.

workspaces.title: Opponent Scouting
workspaces.description: Build opponent hitter and pitcher cards, pitch-type sheets, heat maps, and matchup grids.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Use Wally ScoutingApp as the complete Opponent Scouting workspace, preserving its report calculations, controls, previews, ordering, matchup grid, FTP integration, and PDF downloads inside the BASE visual shell.

workspaces.title: Defensive Analytics
workspaces.description: Analyze positioning, opportunities, range, player value, and catcher receiving.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Combine BASE defensive attribution with Wally opportunity, range/OAA, and framing features only after their metric gates pass.
tools: Defensive leaderboards and OAA after validation
Interactive catcher framing and receiving statistics
workspaces.catching_policy: Interactive catcher statistics live here; the existing catcher PDF generator remains in Postgame Reports. Both use shared catching calculations.

workspaces.title: HomeBASE
workspaces.description: Search any available player and open a role-aware individual snapshot.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Rename and replace BASE Media. Support national search plus direct Texas State roster-card navigation.

entry_points.scope: All players in national pitcher and hitter catalogs plus available team supplements
Open the selected Texas State player directly from the home roster

workspaces.identity_policy: Prefer stable player ID. When unavailable, disambiguate normalized name by team and role; never silently merge same-name players.
workspaces.initial_scope: Navigation, search, identity, and player context only; profile content will be designed later.

workspaces.title: JUCO Scouting
workspaces.description: Search and compare junior-college hitting and pitching leaderboards.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Host Wally's JucoStatsApp inside the BASE shell while preserving its filters, percentile shading, and standalone workflow.

workspaces.title: Data Processing
workspaces.description: Prepare, validate, and correct data used throughout BASE.
workspaces.implementation_policy: Visible to all users for now. Persistent mutations must still disclose source, target, and saved status.

tools.title: Pitch Retagger
tools.storage: Separate SQLite override layer keyed by data source and PitchUID
tools.navigation: Data Processing deep-links directly to the persistent retag controls without creating a second server or pitch-data copy.

tools: Future upload, validation, and preparation utilities
